title_sq: Super Okazion! Prane Tregut Elektrik, Shitet Apartament 4+1+2, Ne Ndertim Te Ri!
description_sq: Super Okazion! Prane Tregut Elektrik, Shitet Apartament 4+1+2, Ne Ndertim Te Ri ! Apartamenti me siperfaqe totale 149.3 m², ndodhet ne katin e 4 banim te nje ndertimi te ri me fasade te ventiluar dhe cilesi te larte ndertimi. Organizohet nga salloni i ndenjes bashke me kendin e gatimit, dhoma matrimoniale me tualet me vete, tre dhomat e gjumit te femijeve, tualeti dites dhe ballkoni. Orientimi i tij eshte Veri-Lindje. Objekti eshte i organizuar me dy kate parkimi nentoke, kati perdhe dedikuar totalisht ambienteve te biznesit dhe mbi te zhvillohen 9 kate banimi. Disa nga benefitet e kompleksit jane: fasade e ventiluar, dritare me dopjo xham me mbushje me gaz per minimizimin e zhurmave dhe termoizolim, izolim akustik ne ndarjet ndermjet apartamenteve, sistem i pergatitur i ngrohjes qendrore. Oborri i brendshem eshte nje hapesire e plotesuar me stola dhe gjelberim, ne pjesen e pasme te kompleksit, pjesa veri-lindore e tij.
title_en: Super Opportunity! Near the Electric Market, 4+1+2 Apartment for Sale, New Building!
description_en: Super Opportunity! Near the Electric Market, Apartment 4+1+2 for sale, in a new building! The apartment with a total area of ​​149.3 m² is located on the 4th residential floor of a new building with a ventilated facade and high quality construction. It is organized by the living room together with the cooking area, the matrimonial room with its own toilet, the three children's bedrooms, the day toilet and the balcony. Its orientation is North-East. The facility is organized with two floors of underground parking, the ground floor is completely dedicated to business premises and 9 residential floors are to be developed above. Some of the benefits of the complex are: ventilated facade, double-glazed windows with gas filling to minimize noise and thermal insulation, acoustic insulation in the partitions between apartments, prepared central heating system. The inner courtyard is a space filled with benches and greenery, at the back of the complex, its north-eastern part.
